newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends at new record high of 4,038.7.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends at new record high of 4,038.7.

text.p: Leading stocks hit another record close in London as benign domestic inflation data and gains in U.S. stocks combined to push prices ahead in a generally quiet London session, traders said.

Shares edged ahead through the afternoon as the Dow broke back above the 6,000 level, the FTSE 100 finishing at a new closing best of 4,038.7, 10.6 points up on the day. Its previous best of 4,035.6 was set on October 8.
But second line stocks failed to follow the FTSE 100's lead, with the mid-250 index which has yet to break its best, set back in April, slipping 0.3 points to 4,443.5.
